## Methods

The distribution of cell_area_um2 was described in each of 3 groups of condition (n = 90, 70, 80). The histogram uses a bin width of 28.49 from the Freedman-Diaconis rule (2 x IQR x n^(-1/3)) on the pooled values, with bins anchored at a multiple of the width. The solid curve is a Gaussian kernel density with the bandwidth of Silverman's rule of thumb (stats::bw.nrd0), and the dashed curve is a normal distribution with the sample mean and SD; both are scaled to counts. Normality was assessed with the Shapiro-Wilk test (control: W = 0.982, P = 0.26; mixed culture: W = 0.883, P < 0.001; serum-starved: W = 0.943, P = 0.0015). Skewness and excess kurtosis are the moment estimates on standardised values (sum(z^3) / n and sum(z^4) / n - 3, with z scaled by the SD). No test compared the groups; use two_group_compare or multi_group_compare to test a difference in location. Computed in Python 3.10.12 with scipy 1.15.3 and drawn with matplotlib 3.10.9.
